title: Sorting filtering and pagination
description: Develop sorting filtering and pagination using Tailwind v4 principles, accessible React markup and a meaningful offline bug-hunt lab.
objectives: Explain the accessibility and design invariant behind sorting filtering and pagination
Reproduce and correct a meaningful failing student assertion
Identify what static SSR proves and what requires a real browser and keyboard
rubric: Reproduce a user-facing failure from the starter
Repair the invariant without changing the assertions
Describe the remaining keyboard, browser and visual QA requirements
